## What Debris Removal Equipment Do Storm Crews Rely On?


Most cleanups come down to four trucks working in sequence:


- **Grapple trucks** clear the road first, picking up limbs, trunks, and brush with a hydraulic boom instead of hand labor.
- **Roll-off trucks** drop and haul containers at collection points so loading never has to stop.
- **Hook lift trucks** do similar container work and can switch bodies quickly between sites.
- **Dump trucks** carry loose debris, soil, and demolition material to disposal and processing sites.


If one truck is missing, the others wait on it. Adding capacity before the next storm beats hunting for trucks after the work orders are in. If you work with a public agency,[FEMA’s debris removal guidance](https://www.fema.gov/assistance/public/process/debris-removal) explains how the process works.


### **Grapple Trucks as Debris Removal Equipment**


Nothing else moves until the road is clear, and a grapple truck clears it faster than a hand crew can. We have grapple trucks in stock with Fassi and Palfinger grapples on Freightliner and Peterbilt chassis. Check current inventory before the next storm.


[See in-stock grapple trucks](https://www.customtruck.com/new/waste-refuse/grapple)


### **Roll-Off Trucks as Debris Removal Equipment**


Once debris is loaded, it needs somewhere to go. Roll-offs let you drop containers at collection points and keep your grapple trucks working while full loads head out. We have roll-off trucks in stock on Peterbilt, Freightliner, Kenworth, and Mack chassis, with Galbreath, Spartan, Palfinger, and Load King hoists.


[See in-stock roll-off trucks](https://www.customtruck.com/new/waste-refuse/roll-off)


### **Hook Lift Trucks: A Faster Container Swap**


Hook lifts handle many of the same container jobs as roll-offs and switch bodies quickly. That makes hook lifts flexible when crews move between sites. Most hook lifts we have in stock use a Palfinger hoist, on Freightliner, Peterbilt, Mack, and Isuzu chassis.


[See in-stock hook lift trucks](https://www.customtruck.com/new/waste-refuse/hook-lift)
